name: Drunken Charge (Combat)
body:
Due to your intoxicated state, you can make charge attacks at unusual angles that startle your opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Ki pool class feature, Drunken Demon

Benefit: Under the effects of the feat Drunken Demon, you can charge as normal up to twice his speed, but it does not need be in a straight line. In addition, if your movement through threatened squares provokes attack of opportunity, make a DC 15 Acrobatic check to negate the attack of opportunity.

As long as you are under the effects of the feat Drunken Demon, you can make use of this feat.
